method: The original Tilda site was crawled by scripts/fetch-source-site.mjs on a GitHub Actions runner (the build sandbox cannot reach it). Raw HTML, texts and all 2 445 downloaded files are on the research/source-fetch branch; this manifest lists the assets actually used by the new site.
